admission.rule: the graph selects verification, it never replaces it; every affected entity carries a tri-valued verdict. global_fallback triggered on pnpm-lock.yaml/pnpm-workspace.yaml (lockfile / global config change), correctly widening the impact set to the whole application (458 nodes) rather than an empty/narrow one -- an empty impact set here would have been the thing needing an explanation, not this one. All entities verified by the single whole-repository verifier appropriate to a dependency-floor change: PR #83's own CI lint-and-test job, run on the real fleet runner, not a local claim -- conclusion success, output_ref https://github.com/Arcanada-one/muneral/actions/runs/34395035927/job/102612514884, this exact head commit. No exemptions needed: nothing here is not_measured.

files.note: archived out of the graph-admission discovery globs; renamed from receipts/graph/change-admission-MUN-node-pin-20260909T175500Z.json, content unchanged

global_fallback.reason: pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml changed ⇒ every node affected (lockfile / global config / env schema: safe fallback, Bazel/Nx practice)

impact_set.method: global fallback: every node of the graph is affected (depth 0, synthetic containment hop); reverse traversal (dependents) + forward declared-by hops (provides_route, implements_contract, maps_model of the same file, deploys_to); best path = fewest inferred/observed hops, then shortest; max_depth 3

staleness.method: manifest.dirty must be false; manifest.source_commit == change_set.base; working tree must be clean (a receipt in diff mode describes committed history only); content_hash of every whole-file node (code_unit, document, receipt; deployable_unit via its package.json) must equal the sha256 of the file bytes at base (git objects); contract/route/data_model hashes are extractor-owned (declaration text) and not recomputed
